protocol.geometry: Unchanged maximum-size axis-aligned window for requested ratio in original image; equally spaced legal free-axis offsets including both endpoints; no scale search.
protocol.utility: Arithmetic mean of continuous-area IoU against all six original human annotations; raw coordinates, no rounding, no inclusive +1.
protocol.oracle: Exhaustive maximum utility over the 129 candidates; ties select smallest candidate index.
protocol.qwen_projection: Nearest legal candidate by free-axis offset to the already produced Qwen crop; ties select smallest candidate index; no new inference.
protocol.aggregation: Mean within each original source, then equal-weight source mean; report all, x-slide, and y-slide separately plus every row.
protocol.hypothesis: Some existing Qwen center outputs miss high-IoU off-center candidates even with maximum-window geometry held fixed.
protocol.competing_explanation: The legal maximum-window candidate set itself cannot match the annotations; oracle utility would then remain low.
protocol.claim_boundary: Same four exposed public sources, GT-assisted posthoc diagnostic. Oracle measures candidate-set adequacy on these rows, not observable information, learnability, independent generalization, B3 performance, or official score.
protocol.independent_unit: Original source video, n=4; ratios, frames and annotations are repeated measurements.
protocol.algorithm_selection: No prompt, model, candidate count, geometry, annotation aggregation or projection tuning from this diagnostic.
protocol.resource_budget: Local CPU only, 24*129*6 rectangle IoU comparisons plus controls; no remote or GPU; no protected or official-test data.
